reply_text:
I didn't record 25 November as Brackenwater's renewal date, because our records give a different date. I replied to Ilse in her #north-team thread and asked where 25 November comes from.

Both the signed 2025-26 renewal order form and the Brackenwater account page (last updated 30 September) say the current term ends, and the account renews, on 30 November 2026. Dana's handover email from September 2025 also gave 30 November as the renewal date.

One older CRM note from February 2026 says the renewal is 31 December 2026. It conflicts with the signed contract, and I didn't use it.

I asked Ilse whether 25 November comes from an amendment, from a change the customer asked for, or is just a target to get it signed early. Until she answers, the record stays at 30 November.

My reply only mentioned dates, which anyone on the account's team may see. I left out all money terms.
